Author: Kestrels Nest
Name: NEBO
Description: NEBO (DCS ATC/GCI) on your Stream Deck: engagement lines 1–8, SRS channels, labels, workspace and map filters.

Actions.Name: Engagement
Actions.Tooltip: Engagement line with this marker (1–8): range, colour by its alert; press to show it on the map

Actions.Name: SRS channel
Actions.Tooltip: Your SRS channel (1–10): frequency, role; press to transmit on it

Actions.Name: Labels
Actions.Tooltip: GCI maps' labels: Full → Short → None

Actions.Name: Label position
Actions.Tooltip: GCI maps' label position: above the aircraft or beside its vector

Actions.Name: GCI / ATC
Actions.Tooltip: Switch between the GCI and ATC workspaces

Actions.Name: Map filter
Actions.Tooltip: A GCI map filter on/off: ground units, landed, threat rings, F10 marks, TGP, zones, airfields

Actions.Name: Players only (hold)
Actions.Tooltip: While held: GCI maps show only aircraft flown by people
